title: auditActiveEffectIntegrity reports a live combat link of a durable summon as a stale persistent link
description: Found integrating eshyra-0dtg (Pipes test, PR to come). auditActiveEffectIntegrity (packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts, stalePersistentLinks) flags EVERY active actor link with target_kind combatant and a non-null campaign_actor_id as 'persistent actor link still points at combatant'. During an ACTIVE combat that is the normal state: rebindCombatantReferencesToActor retargets those links to the campaign actor only at combat closure (or a bonded-summon transition). So the audit appears to over-report for any durable summon bound mid-combat (Pipes swarms; likely Horn of Valhalla berserkers and other untimed or hour-scale item grants). Re-derive: should the predicate exclude links whose combatant is in an active combat instance? Confirm against the closure and replay code and every caller of the audit; fix the predicate or document the intended call point; add a regression for a live durable summon mid-combat (clean) and after closure without a rebind (flagged). Pre-freeze: the integrity audit's in-band scope must be truthful (ADR 0020 bar).
notes: Captain 2026-11-07: integrated e1ab87b2 (merged with main) after own review and verify (exit 0, 7489). PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/732. Stays in_progress until merged.
